VIRGINIA SLIMS
WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP SERIES

BIOGRAPHY
EDYTHE ANN MCGOLDRICK
TOURNAMENT DIRECTOR -- 1983 VIRGINIA SLIMS OF BOSTON

Edythe Ann ("Edy") McGoldrick, President of Six Love Promotions, Inc., Wellesley, MA, is the Tournament Director for the 1983 Virginia Slims of Boston. Last year, Mrs. McGoldrick served as Tournament Director for the successful 1982 Avon Championships of Boston, the finals of which were played before 8,493; the largest crowd in the history of professional tennis tournaments (men's or women's) in New England.
From 1977 to 1981, Mrs. McGoldrick was Vice-President of Capital Sports, an international sports marketing firm. During her term with Capital Sports, McGoldrick transformed the Federation Cup, the women's equivalent to the Davis Cup, into a world class event, and was a consultant to the 1980 Lake Placid Olympic Games.
Other McGoldrick achievements include the founding of the first women's satellite tour for young tennis-players, which currently has developed into the Ginny Circuit; and as a consultant to Colgate (Palmolive). McGoldrick expanded the Colgate Series Tour to include tournaments worldwide. Mrs. McGoldrick also served as the Executive Director of Women's Tennis for the United States Tennis Association, 1973 to 1976.
